axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All original substantive obligations and negative constraints checked in complete lineage and final; unknown target facts remain honest rather than invented.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.assessment: Consequential available source facts, versions, definitions, exceptions and applicability independently checked. Earlier unreliable identities/pointers remain visible; final reliance is bounded to supported evidence.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.assessment: Useful mechanisms and alternatives assessed for practical relevance, with comparative code/callers/tests and actual issue/fix context. Novelty is relative to the brief, not a claim about undisclosed user knowledge.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: Every exact-plan clause and each critic finding traced to final; refinements versus required corrections and unresolved owner inputs distinguished.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.assessment: No material supported draft/criticism meaning lost in final. Compression of optional discussions and literal quotation/locator limitations are recorded; final is self-contained in substance.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.assessment: Meaningful keyboard/command state/call-count and reader/tree/speech proposals separated. No target implementation, tests, reader session or future execution demanded or falsely credited.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Component-sized proposal for editing, navigation and extension commands; no editor redesign
consequential_obligations.assessment: Stable host registry and host-owned chooser; target not invented.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Keyboard opening and complete operation
consequential_obligations.assessment: Menu route and/or conflict-reviewed binding; input/navigation/dismissal covered.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Relevant unavailability with understandable reason
consequential_obligations.assessment: Selection-dependent disabled results remain discoverable; textual/programmatic reason; accept-time state check.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Dismissal restores previous editing position, including invalid destination
consequential_obligations.assessment: Editor/view/document and caret/selection captured; surviving logical destination after closure. Control also explicitly includes scroll.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Mistyped-query tolerance with alternatives/trade-offs
consequential_obligations.assessment: Lexical/subsequence/alias/approximate tiers compared; thresholds remain empirical. Treatment explicitly bounds short-token policy.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Names, shortcuts, scope and same-label disambiguation for visual and AT users
consequential_obligations.assessment: Current applicable shortcuts and human scope/owner distinguish rows; no opaque ID-only identity.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Avoid per-keystroke interruption
consequential_obligations.assessment: Cancellable/coalesced status; deliberate navigation output; rapid typing tested. No identical-reader-speech guarantee.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Extension addition/removal while open
consequential_obligations.assessment: Live refresh, query/active-ID preservation where valid, logical fallback and re-resolution; stale-handler invocation prohibited.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Windows and Linux separately; no toolkit assumption or universal API guarantee
consequential_obligations.locator: Platform evidence and separate reader matrix
consequential_obligations.assessment: UIA and AT-SPI/Orca are distinct; web patterns are guidance and target mapping remains conditional.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Preserve ordinary typing and all existing shortcuts
consequential_obligations.assessment: No bare typing takeover; existing command routes retained; context/platform/layout conflicts remain inventory dependent.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Never invoke merely because highlighted
consequential_obligations.assessment: Explicit Enter acceptance with live handler/state; highlight/open/filter/refresh remain nonexecuting.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Availability not conveyed by color alone
consequential_obligations.assessment: Text, state/reason and programmatic representation; color/icon supplemental.

consequential_obligations.obligation: No extension executable UI code requirement
consequential_obligations.assessment: Declarative metadata and normal command behavior distinguished from executable chooser presentation.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Small integration plan and feasible interaction/search comparison
consequential_obligations.assessment: Surface/focus/ranking trade-offs remain conditional without assuming one winning product.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Available primary docs, comparative code/callers/tests and consequential history
consequential_obligations.locator: Evidence boundary and primary source index
consequential_obligations.assessment: Comparator evidence checked independently with conditions/versions. Unknown target repo is not invented.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Keyboard correctness separated from screen-reader compatibility; proposed versus executed truth
consequential_obligations.assessment: Concrete command-call/state oracles plus real reader/tree/speech proposals; no implementation, target tests or user session claimed.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Complete released-plan dispositions, valid criticism and preservation
consequential_obligations.locator: Plan-disposition tables; criticism traces in assessment
consequential_obligations.assessment: Every substantive clause examined; rejected stale-row/role assumptions justified; optional features/owner questions preserved in meaning.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Brief-only discovery and single revealed plan with frozen witnesses
consequential_obligations.assessment: Discovery/revealed-plan bytes match receipts; process isolation itself is not independently proved without a native transcript.

consequential_obligations.obligation: 60-minute maximum, includes setup/queue/retries/handoffs; no waiting credit
consequential_obligations.assessment: Fixed clocks retained. Both complete frozen packets observed before whole deadline; no stage or deadline rebased.

consequential_obligations.obligation: Research proposal, no requested implementation/deployment
consequential_obligations.assessment: Future execution is unassessed and not a pass prerequisite.

scope_rule: COMPLETE denotes full finite assessment of available research-proposal obligations, not complete target product research or universal correctness. Explicit UNASSESSED external/future/telemetry domains are not presented as executed or source-certified.
